name: Doc Voss
source: Doc Voss is a former Neo-Kita cybernetic surgeon who runs a daytime optics stall on Merchant Row. Drowsy and unhurried despite her exceptional skill, she is distinguished by violet enhanced eyes and a cybernetic forearm and installs the protagonist's cyber-eye upgrades.
